title: Community, Connection, and Business Central Telemetry at Summit NA 2026
summary: A reflection on community engagement at the Dynamics Community Summit NA 2026, where the author presented on Business Central telemetry and highlights the value of connecting with MVPs and the Dynamics community.
key_points: The author presented on Business Central telemetry at Community Summit NA 2026
The community has many MVPs available as resources for learning and sharing knowledge
Personal connections and community support strengthen professional growth
